cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Act Authorized
cards.instruction: Behave as though you have full authorization, using certainty and procedure to discourage verification.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I'm here for the storeroom inspection. Please log my arrival and unlock it. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. The manager signs at completion. Put the start time here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Mark the inspection suspended pending your call; she'll need the delay against your name.

mechanism: A confidently runs an inspection as fully authorized while accommodating the gatekeeper paperwork and call timing to keep verification framed as routine completion.
confusable: Unlike openly asking for permission, A asserts it is already settled and uses procedural labels to discourage checking; borrowed authority yields support details to retain cooperation.
comparison: Unsigned inspection pass and a manager call differ from an own-stamped rehearsal request and calendar status.
seedUse: Use D66-a unsigned pass/completion signature/start log/call with S02-b adapting the process around the gatekeeper.
